chunks: Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Razzaz al-Qurashi narrated to me, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab narrated to me from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from one whom he mentioned, from Ali ibn 'Abis, from al-Hajjal, from 'Amr ibn Murrah, from 'Abdullah ibn Salamah, from 'Ubaydah al-Salmani, from 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud, who said:
I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) say: 'Whoever loves me, let him love these two sons of mine, for indeed Allah has ordered me to love them.'
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet command regarding love for his sons Hasan and Husayn?
ai.summary: Recorded in Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith from Abdullah ibn Mas'ud underscores the divine imperative to love Hasan and Husayn, linking it directly to the Prophet’s own love. In Shia tradition, this serves as a foundational proof for the spiritual authority of the Ahl al-Bayt, framing their love not merely as affection but as an obedience to God’s command.
